The freelance quarterly close checklist

Published {{DATE}} by Amara Okafor

  1. Send every outstanding invoice and chase anything over 30 days.
  2. Photograph and file every receipt; Ledgerly reads the amount and date.
  3. Reconcile bank transactions against invoices and expenses.
  4. Export the quarterly report and share it with your accountant.
